title: Customer Success Manager (Italy)
description:
Basis:


Permanent Full Time


Area of Interest:


Support Operations


Location:


Ferrara, Italy


**Who we are:**
---------------


Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web\-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third\-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities \- ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.**Who you are:**
----------------



We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Customer Success Manager (SMB) who will own a portfolio of SMB customers, drive measurable outcomes through value\-based engagement, and maximize net retention and growth. If you love building long\-term customer relationships and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!


**What you'll do:**
-------------------



As a Customer Success Manager (SMB), your key area of responsibility will be managing a book of business across your assigned portfolio of SMB accounts, ensuring customers realize continuous value from onboarding through renewal and expansion. You will be responsible for validating customer goals, building actionable success plans, leading onboarding and enablement, and conducting proactive health checks and success reviews. You will also need to monitor customer health signals, own the renewals pipeline, and identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities in partnership with Sales.



To be successful in this role you will be a commercially minded, customer\-centric professional with a structured and proactive approach to managing a high\-volume account portfolio. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong analytical abilities, excellent cross\-functional collaboration skills, and a genuine passion for building trust\-based partnerships with SMB stakeholders.


**How you'll make an impact:**
------------------------------


* Own the customer lifecycle for an assigned portfolio of accounts, ensuring a consistent, value\-driven experience from onboarding through renewal and expansion.
* Deeply understand customer objectives by validating and documenting key business goals, defining success criteria, and building actionable success plans to achieve those outcomes.
* Lead onboarding, education, and enablement of new customers by delivering structured implementation, training, and best\-practice guidance that drive rapid adoption and accelerate time\-to\-value, platform proficiency, and ongoing value realization.
* Build and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with key customer stakeholders and decision\-makers, becoming a strategic partner in their business.
* Conduct proactive, value\-led customer engagements (e.g., success reviews, health checks) to drive adoption, retention, and account growth.
* Monitor customer health and early churn indicators, develop mitigation plans, and execute targeted interventions to reduce risk and improve retention.
* Identify, qualify, and influence growth opportunities (upsell, cross\-sell, referrals) in partnership with the Sales team.
* Own and proactively manage the renewals pipeline, identifying risks, driving renewal strategies, and securing timely renewals.
* Respond to and resolve customer inquiries and escalations related to product, contractual, and operational topics, coordinating internal resources as needed.
* Forecast, track, and report on key customer metrics, including health, product adoption, retention, NPS/CSAT, and recurring revenue.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally, providing structured feedback and insights to Product, Sales, Support, and Operations to influence roadmap and process improvements.
* Support local teams with contractual topics, strategic customer communications, and project\-based initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with global and cross\-functional teams to deliver a consistent, high\-quality customer experience and scalable success motions.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date account records and activities in CRM and CS platforms to ensure visibility and coordination across teams.
* Leverage data and AI for product usage, customer health scores, and analytics to prioritize outreach, refine success plans, and drive adoption.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Customer Success playbooks, processes, and tooling based on frontline learnings.

**What you'll bring to the role:**
----------------------------------



* Equivalent combination of education and/or work experience in a related field may be substituted
* Relevant experience in Customer Success and/or Account Management, ideally with a proven track record of customer retention and growth (mandatory)
* General understanding of IoT/telematics products and solutions; experience in B2B SaaS is a strong advantage
* Fluent written and verbal communication in English and Italian
* Additional European language skills are an advantage (not mandatory)
* Excellent communication, listening, negotiation, and presentation skills (mandatory)
* Comfort with commercial motions: renewals, contract and price negotiations, upsell/cross\-sell in partnership with Sales; good understanding of contracts and pricing impact on profitability
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer data, health metrics, and usage patterns to drive decisions and priorities
* Experience working with CRM and CS tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, Gainsight) is an advantage (not mandatory)
* Methodical, conscientious approach to documentation and maintaining accurate records in CRM/CS systems
* Excellent time management, organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage a portfolio of accounts in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment (mandatory)
* Structured, proactive can\-do mindset for managing open matters and tasks in a demanding environment
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and international teams
* Growth mindset with a strong willingness to learn, openness to feedback, and ability to self\-reflect to improve performance
* Customer\-centric attitude and a passion for building long\-term, value\-based customer relationships
* Anticipated travel and/or use of a personal vehicle for business purposes
If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

**Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.**

**This posting is for an existing vacancy.**
**How we work:**
----------------


At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in\-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud\-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work\-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!

We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

Manager, PMO
  
  

Alfasigma is a privately held global healthcare company founded over 75 years ago in Italy, where it remains headquartered today in Bologna and Milan. The Group operates in over 100 markets spanning Europe, North and South America, Asia, and Africa.
  
  

Over three years ago, we embarked on a transformative journey to become a truly global innovative healthcare company with a leading focus on Gastrointestinal (GI) health. We have experienced remarkable growth, nearly doubled our revenues, expanding geographically, and integrating several key acquisitions. We have also evolved our portfolio, expanded into rare and specialty segments, and strengthened our pipeline and people's capabilities.
  
  

But our journey is far from complete! In fact, this is just the beginning of a bold new chapter in Alfasigma's history. We are committed to advancing innovation and leveraging our deep expertise to provide better health and a better quality of life for patients and consumers worldwide and expand our reach across diverse markets.
  
  

Scope of the role
  
  

As part of the Global Facility \& EHS organization, this role will play a key part in driving the transformation and continuous improvement of Facility Management and Environmental Health \& Safety practices across the Group. The position will support the design, coordination, and execution of global initiatives aimed at enhancing operational excellence, governance, asset performance, service delivery, and compliance standards across multiple sites and geographies.
  
  

The successful candidate will partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure the effective implementation of the Facility \& EHS transformation roadmap, overseeing project execution, performance monitoring, process harmonization, and change management activities. The role will also contribute to the development of data\-driven decision\-making frameworks, standardized maintenance practices, and global governance models that support business growth, efficiency, sustainability, and workforce safety.
  
  

Your role
  
  

Support the definition and execution of the Global Facility \& EHS Transformation roadmap, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives, priorities, timelines, and expected business benefits
  
Coordinate transformation initiatives across sites and functions, monitoring progress, risks, dependencies, milestones, resources, and overall program delivery
  
Coordinate the harmonization of maintenance and service management practices and re\-engineering, including preventive and predictive maintenance approaches, CMMS deployment and Facility performance metrics standardization
  
Develop and maintain a robust performance management framework, including KPIs, dashboards, and structured performance reviews to track progress and drive accountability
  
Support the design and deployment of global service delivery and governance models, leveraging data analytics to enhance decision\-making, transparency, and operational effectiveness
  
Monitor real estate and Facility asset performance across the Group, supporting asset optimization, CAPEX prioritization, and alignment with business requirements
  
Lead and coordinate change management activities to facilitate the adoption of new standards, processes, governance models, and digital tools across the Facility \& EHS organization
  
Support the deployment and monitoring of global EHS standards, policies, and compliance initiatives, promoting consistency, regulatory adherence, and a strong safety culture across all sites
  
Prepare executive reports, governance materials, business cases, and strategic analyses for senior leadership and steering committees, ensuring visibility of program progress, risks, and value realization
  
  

**who are you:**  

Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration (MBA), Facility Management, or equivalent is preferred
  
Strong experience in governance, KPI and dashboard design, performance measurement, executive reporting, process reengineering, and oversight of strategic transformation programs
  
Exposure to Facility Management operating models, asset management, maintenance excellence, workplace services, and CAPEX planning is mandatory
  
Knowledge of Facility Management and asset lifecycle management principles
  
Familiarity with EHS management systems, risk management, compliance programs, and safety culture initiatives.
  
Financial acumen, including CAPEX/OPEX monitoring, budgeting, and business case development
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools

title: Strategic R&D Manager - Wound Management
description:
Company: B. Braun Avitum Italy S.p.A.
Job Posting Location: Mirandola, Emilia Romagna, Italia
Functional Area: Research and Development
Working Model: Hybrid
Requisition ID: 13330
B. Braun Avitum is a global medical device and therapy partner within the B. Braun Group, with established expertise in Wound Management. Guided by our mission of *Sharing Expertise* , we work in close partnership with healthcare professionals to develop safe, effective, and sustainable wound management solutions that protect and improve the health of patients worldwide. Through scientific excellence, responsible innovation, and long‑term commitment to sustainability, we continuously advance our wound care portfolio. To support our long‑term growth strategy within the business, we are seeking an experienced Strategic R\&D Manager to lead and shape the future development of our wound care portfolio in strong collaboration with our global partners and stakeholders.

  

**Position Summary**

The Strategic R\&D Manager will define and drive the medium‑ to long‑term R\&D strategy for the wound management business, with clear accountability for portfolio management and prioritization. This role sits at the intersection of innovation, clinical needs, and business strategy, translating market and clinical insights into differentiated product platforms and sustainable technology and product roadmaps. The position includes steering internal development activities as well as managing and coordinating third‑party development partners to accelerate innovation and optimize resource allocation. The ideal candidate is a visionary yet hands‑on leader with deep wound care expertise and strong cross‑functional influence across global stakeholders.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy \& Portfolio Development**

* Define, own and implement the R\&D strategy and technology roadmap for wound management with the internal R\&D departments and in close collaboration with Global Marketing (GM), ensuring alignment with portfolio, brand positioning, and customer value propositions
* Lead and align R\&D activities across Sempach and Mirandola, in close collaboration with Project Managers and Strategic Procurement, to secure efficient development, cost competitiveness, supplier integration, and smooth industrialization of innovative wound management solutions.
* Drive portfolio prioritization and investment decisions together with GM, aligning innovation initiatives with business objectives, market attractiveness, and lifecycle management
* Identify unmet users and patients’ needs as well as market trends through structured cooperation with GM, clinical experts, and key opinion leaders

· Build competitive technology positioning and clear differentiation by translating marketing and customer insights into robust product platforms  

**Cross‑Functional Leadership**

* Act as key R\&D partner to Marketing, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and Operations
* Support M\&A, licensing, or external innovation scouting activities
* Communicate strategy and progress to senior leadership and stakeholders

  

**Team \& Capability Leadership**

* Lead and mentor R\&D scientists and engineers
* Foster a high‑performance, innovation‑driven culture
* Build core competencies in wound management technologies, materials, and systems
* Actively promote “Sharing Expertise” by collaborating with and transferring knowledge to other business divisions across the B. Braun Group, leveraging synergies and best practices to accelerate innovation and portfolio value

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Master’s or PhD in Biomedical Engineering, Materials Science, Life Sciences, Natural Sciences or related field
* 5\+ years of R\&D experience in medical devices
* Strong background in wound management / wound healing products
* Proven experience in R\&D strategy, portfolio management, or innovation leadership
* Solid understanding of ISO 13485, MDR / FDA requirements
* Fluency in English; German language is a plus

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile (“Winning Profile”)**

* Strategic thinker with strong execution capability
* Deep scientific and technical credibility in wound care
* Business‑oriented mindset with customer and patient focus
* Comfortable influencing at executive level
* Resilient, curious, and passionate about innovation

  

**What We Offer**

* High‑impact strategic role in a growing global business
* Competitive executive compensation package
* Opportunity to shape future wound care technologies
* International exposure and career growth potential
* Collaborative, science‑driven culture

  

 Compensation details: Salary range: € 70\.000 \- € 80\.000 Gross Annual Salary (RAL) \+ MBO.
The aforementioned range represents the estimated remuneration for the position. The final gross annual salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience and skills, in compliance with applicable European regulations on pay transparency and pay equity.

title: Utilities & Facility Engineer
description:
Reporting directly to the *Maintenance Manager*, the role holds full strategic and operational responsibility. The **Senior Utilities \& Facility Engineer** will ensure the operational continuity, utilities optimization, and regulatory compliance across two industrial manufacturing plants located in **Parma** and in the province of **Reggio Emilia**.


They will coordinate two in‑house operators (one per plant), handling ordinary maintenance activities on the systems while interacting with internal electrical and mechanical workshops. The role also includes full management and supervision of a network of external collaborators, consultants, and suppliers for specialized maintenance, inspections, and continuous improvement activities.

**Mission**


The ideal candidate is a professional with a strong technical background and proven experience in industrial utilities management and facility maintenance within complex manufacturing environments. The main objective is to ensure maximum operational continuity, lead advanced energy‑efficiency and decarbonization projects, guarantee full regulatory compliance of the plants, and optimize operating costs.


One of the main responsibilities for the role is the update and maintenance of all technical and legal documentation related to environmental and safety matters (HSE) linked to their area of responsibility. Additionally, the **Senior Utilities \& Facility Engineer** will be a champion for the paperless system digitalization plan for utilities and facility maintenance, driving the transition toward integrated HSE and maintenance platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**


The daily tasks will be carried out evenly across both industrial plants. Main duties include:

* **Utilities Governance \& Process Equipment Optimization** — Strategic overview, operational and performance optimization of service systems: thermal power plants, compressed air systems, fluid/gas distribution networks, and cooling water generation/distribution systems. Advanced technical management of critical assets such as chillers and industrial burners, maximizing reliability (MTBF) and minimizing downtime.
* **Strategic Facility Management** — Definition and supervision of extraordinary and conservative maintenance plans for buildings, yards, auxiliary structures, and plant roofing, including budget management.
* **Energy Management, Sustainability \& Decarbonization** — Advanced analysis of energy carriers (electricity, gas, water), implementation of consumption‑monitoring systems, and design/execution of energy‑efficiency projects aimed at sustainability and carbon‑footprint reduction.
* **Supplier Management \& Technical Procurement** — Negotiation and management of maintenance contracts (SLA/KPI), supervision of complex on‑site works, rigorous verification of work progress (SAL), and full economic cycle management from offer approval to final invoice validation.
* **Legislative Compliance, Safety \& HSE** — Ensuring full legal compliance of all systems (mandatory inspections, fire‑safety regulations, PED directive). Active collaboration with the HSE Manager (RSPP) for drafting and applying safety documentation (DUVRI, POS, site safety plans) for all external contractors.
* **Digitalization Leadership** — Design, implementation, and roll‑out of an integrated paperless system for digitalizing registers, certifications, and technical documentation related to utilities and facility management, making it fully accessible online for HSE and Maintenance departments.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Industrial Management, or Civil/Environmental Engineering.

**Experience**

* Proven experience (minimum 5–8 years) as Facility/Utilities Engineer or Manager, preferably within complex and structured industrial manufacturing environments (metalworking or food industry is a strong plus).

**Technical Skills**

* Deep technical knowledge of thermal systems, compressed air systems, refrigeration plants, and industrial burners.
* Proficiency in reading P\&ID diagrams, electrical schematics, and CAD layouts.
* Solid understanding of the PED Directive, fire‑safety regulations, and Energy Management frameworks (e.g., ISO 50001\).
* Excellent command of Microsoft Office Suite.

**Language Skills**

* Proficient English level, both spoken and written, for documentation management and to liaise with international partners and vendors.

**Logistics \& Soft Skills**

* Valid driving license (Category B) and availability for regular commute between Parma and Reggio Emilia sites.
* Strong leadership, people‑management attitude, excellent negotiation skills, strategic vision, advanced problem‑solving capabilities, and proactivity.
* **Environment \& Growth:** Opportunity to operate with high autonomy and responsibility within a market‑leading organization. The role offers strategic visibility across plant operations and serves as a key pillar for operational efficiency and ecological transition, with concrete prospects for professional development.

description:
